resources.string: On a device with a second screen, starts a second stream of the same game on it, at that screen\'s own resolution. The second stream is a device of its own to the PC and is paired once with a PIN, like another install. The first screen keeps the sound, the controllers and the microphone, and a touch mode change on either screen applies to both. The PC must allow two devices to stream at once, and decides which of its screens each one shows. Takes effect on the next stream.
The second screen streams as a device of its own, so the PC pairs it once. Enter this PIN in your host\'s settings or web UI, usually on its PIN or pairing page.\n\n%1$s
